title: About Us
description: We're a small team of designers, developers, and strategists who believe great software should be simple, fast, and built to last.
mission: Our mission is to make digital experiences more human — removing friction, adding clarity, and putting real people at the center of every decision we make.
body:
## Our Story

Acme Digital started in 2018 with a simple idea: that small businesses deserve the same quality of software as the big ones. Since then we've helped over 200 clients across 12 industries launch products they're genuinely proud of.

## Our Values

**Simplicity** — We cut scope before we cut corners.

**Transparency** — You always know where your project stands.

**Craftsmanship** — We sweat the details so your users don't have to.
